explanation: The UAV collided with a static obstacle at 7.4 seconds due to late detection at 6.6 seconds, leaving only 0.8 seconds to react. Counterfactual analysis confirms that reducing the cruise speed of 8.2 m/s or eliminating the 0.42 m sensor noise would have prevented the failure. The limited sensing range of 6.4 m was a critical constraint that prevented the planner from identifying the obstacle in time.
